summary.whatChanges: Type-only change: moves the `BrowserTraceEntryKind` and `MarkOptions` browser trace types into Vitest's public browser module and re-exports them from the browser context entry points, and drops the side-effect `@vitest/expect` type import that pulled in chai types from `vitest/config.d.ts`.
behaviorChanges: `BrowserTraceEntryKind` and `MarkOptions` are now exported from `vitest/internal/browser` and `vitest/browser/context` instead of being declared locally in `@vitest/browser`'s context types.
`vitest/config` no longer transitively pulls in `@vitest/expect`/chai type declarations.
risks: Projects relying on `vitest/config` to implicitly provide chai global types may now see TypeScript errors and need an explicit import.
If `vitest/internal/browser` isn't resolvable in a consumer's setup, `@vitest/browser`'s context types now fail to resolve `BrowserTraceEntryKind`/`MarkOptions` that were previously declared inline.
Duplicate re-exports of the same names across multiple browser context entry points could cause export-conflict type errors.
